credit: Data from MetaBot.GG (https://metabot.gg/en/aion-2/crafting); credit must be given with a dofollow link to the specific metabot.gg page the data came from.
notes: Complete: all 512 recipes on the site (5 professions; 256 per faction, Elyos and Asmodian mirrored lists with the same item names but different recipe_id).
kinah: 0 on every recipe, per metabot.gg crafting guide ("No recipe charges Kinah. The crafting fee field is 0 on every recipe in the client").

success_rate: normal-craft success at exactly the required mastery (gap +0), as a fraction. It rises with mastery above the recipe level; full curves (index = mastery gap 0..) are in success_curves, keyed by success_curve. 210 recipes (mostly upgrade recipes) have no curve in the client (null).

combo_chance: chance the game rolls a combo (great success) after a successful craft; combo_success_rate is the gap +0 chance that the combo then succeeds (curve in success_curves keyed by recipe rate[1]).

great: filled only for gear where the Splendent version (name pattern) exists and is used as an ingredient of the next recipe in the line, matching the site guide ("a great success gives Splendent X"). The pairing is inferred from names, not read from a field. Other recipes have great: [] but still carry combo_chance; the site does not state their combo result item.
mastery = proficiency level required. Item names are as spelled by the source.
